National Special Projects Office
Letter of Recommendation
LETTER OF RECOMMENDATION
Our ref: 97
31 Mar 2026
This office has engaged M/s National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. for the work “Cable Stayed
Bridge — Delhi Pkg-109” (Rs. 11360.00 Lakh), completed on 24 Dec 2013. On the basis of that
engagement we record the following:
Adherence to the sanctioned programme of work and milestone dates;
Quality of workmanship accepted at inspection without material objection;
Compliance with safety and statutory obligations on site;
Responsiveness of the contractor's site management.
The contractor's planning, quality control and coordination with this office were of a good
standard, and the work was commissioned without outstanding defects.
Verification: Uma Patel, ee@dept.gov.in, +91-9830000000.
